:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: questions 

- What does bulk RNA-sequencing measure?
- How does bulk RNA-sequencing technology work?
- What are some applications of bulk RNA-sequencing?

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: objectives

- Explain what biological molecules RNA-sequencing measures. 
- Explain the process of RNA-sequencing, including RNA isolation, library preparation, and sequencing.
- Give examples of applications of RNA-sequencing.

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

## Introduction

Outline:

- What the course will cover:
- RNASeq technology & process.
- FASTQ QC.
- Building a reference index.
- Alignment using STAR.
- Quantification using RSEM.
- JAX CS-NF pipeline to do this.
- DE using DESeq2.
- Pathway analysis using ??? (GSEA, Gostats, Enrichr)
- Not sure: WGCNA, cell-type deconvolution, 

- Measuring RNA via microarray.Show brief overview, idea of compelmentary sequences &
fluorescent tags, taking pictures to measure light intensity and quantification.
- Early Solexa seq-by-synth. Library prep. Taking pictures of fluorescent dyes for each base.
High level only.
- Costs of sequencing over time. High throughput.
-
